## What Are Dictation Apps for iPhone?


Writing a detailed reply on your iPhone can mean repeated thumb typing and cursor corrections. Dictation apps turn speech into text so you can speak your thought, then review it on screen.


If you're weighing options for[Apple speech to text on iPhone](https://willowvoice.com/blog/apple-speech-to-text-iphone-dictation-guide) , choose the type based on where you need the text and how much writing help you want:


-


Keyboard-based dictation puts spoken words into the message or document you're writing.


-


Standalone transcription captures speech in a separate app for review before sharing.


-


AI writing tools turn spoken instructions into drafts or rewrite existing text, helping with composition beyond transcription.


## How We Ranked Dictation Apps for iPhone


We at Willow Voice compared public product documentation, without independent hands-on testing. Our criteria:


-


iPhone availability and input workflow, favoring writing directly in apps over desktop-only features.


-


Personalization and editing capabilities.


-


Privacy, free access, and cross-device continuity.


We distinguish documented restrictions from unconfirmed availability and exclude unpublished benchmarks and unsupported older claims. For measured results from controlled testing, see our[full dictation accuracy and speed benchmark](https://willowvoice.com/blog/dictation-accuracy-zero-edit-rate-benchmark) .


Aqua Voice now documents an iPhone app. Dragon Anywhere reportedly[ended sales and renewals](https://www.getvoibe.com/resources/dragon-anywhere-discontinued/) on July 1, 2026. The six entries cover five current candidates and one legacy option for existing subscribers; Dragon Anywhere is no longer a purchase recommendation. For everyday iPhone writing, use Apple's built-in dictation as your baseline and judge each app by how much editing it saves.

## Willow Voice: Dictation for iPhone Writing and Teams


For teams and professionals who write all day, Willow Voice pairs 98%+ accuracy with ~200ms latency, so client replies and status updates come out clean on the first pass. Shared dictionaries, admin controls, SOC 2 Type II, and HIPAA compliance let organizations roll out the same setup across every device. Individuals can try the free plan first: unlimited dictation through the iOS keyboard, with no word cap or credit card. Paid plans add faster, more accurate, and more intelligent dictation, plus unlimited Willow Scribe for AI-assisted drafting.


### What They Offer


-


~200ms cloud latency: text appears almost as fast as you finish speaking, with no jarring pause.


-


Auto-Dictionary learns corrections over time; vocabulary syncs across Windows, Mac, and iOS so your setup follows you between devices.


-


Willow Scribe on iOS: Draft mode generates complete messages from a spoken prompt; Edit mode rewrites selected text by voice. If you also work on a tablet, see our roundup of[dictation apps for iPad](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-speech-to-text-apps-ipad) for device-specific picks.


For teams deploying across devices, shared custom dictionaries and admin controls push consistent vocabulary (client names, project terms, internal shorthand) to Windows workstations, Mac laptops, and iOS devices alike, without per-user setup. Team leaderboards give managers visibility into adoption and time saved across the group. Enterprise-grade security includes SOC 2 Type II certification, HIPAA compliance, and zero data retention, making org-wide rollout fit within existing security review requirements from day one.


## superwhisper


superwhisper offers iPhone dictation with AI-assisted output and keyboard input for users who want configurable settings.


### What They Offer


-


Keyboard access lets you enter text by voice.


-


Configurable voice and AI model options let you tune input and output.


Its[iOS setup guide](https://superwhisper.com/docs/get-started/ios) states the keyboard needs Allow Full Access to transcribe audio and insert text, that it supports iPhone only (no iPad), that modes and vocabulary are stored per device and do not sync from a Mac or PC yet, and that a Pro license covers iOS at no extra cost.


Choose it if you prefer adjusting settings yourself. Willow Voice offers automatic vocabulary learning and unlimited free dictation for users who prefer less configuration. Android users comparing options can check our guide to[speech to text apps for Android](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-speech-to-text-apps-android) .


## VoiceInk


If you need to capture a thought on your phone, VoiceInk's[iPhone App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/voiceink-ai-dictation/id6751431158) confirms mobile availability.


### What They Offer


-


AI dictation for turning spoken thoughts into text.


-


Quick notes and transcription for personal idea capture.


-


Offline transcription with local models, or cloud transcription providers through your own API keys.


Its note-taking focus may suit individual use. For a team purchase, verify shared dictionaries, vocabulary sync, and centralized administration before committing: those capabilities remain unconfirmed in the listing. The buying distinction is personal capture versus managed team deployment.


## Monologue


Monologue suits readers who want iPhone dictation and spoken-note capture, including thoughts recorded during a walk. See our[Monologue vs. Wispr Flow comparison](https://willowvoice.com/blog/monologue-vs-wispr-flow-which-to-use) if you're deciding between the two.


### What They Offer


-


Voice notes and bot-free meeting capture for saving thoughts and conversations.


-


Availability on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.


The[Monologue App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/monologue-smart-dictation/id6755956193) describes a free download with in-app purchases. The listing states you can start free with 1,000 dictation words and 10 notes, while Monologue Pro unlocks unlimited dictation, unlimited notes, and bot-free meetings.


Choose Monologue if notes and meetings are your main use case. For ongoing writing, Willow Voice offers unlimited free dictation and vocabulary continuity across Mac, Windows, and iOS, backed by enterprise-grade security.


## Aqua Voice


Aqua Voice’s iPhone keyboard supports spoken input and corrections while you compose messages.


### What They Offer


-


Dictation into the active app, producing punctuated text you can review before sending (see our[Aqua Voice vs. Wispr Flow](https://willowvoice.com/blog/aqua-voice-vs-wispr-flow-comparison-review) comparison for more on how it stacks up).


-


Voice-based text editing for making corrections by speaking.


The[iPhone keyboard access terms](https://aquavoice.com/ios) specify a free allowance of 1,000 words and require iOS 17 or later.


Aqua is worth considering if spoken corrections matter to you; for other options, see our roundup of[Aqua Voice alternatives](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-aqua-voice-alternatives) . If the free allowance is too small for your daily writing, Willow Voice offers unlimited free dictation and vocabulary learning as an alternative.


## Dragon Anywhere


Dragon Anywhere is a legacy mobile document-dictation app.


### What They Offer


Its App Store listing describes these document-dictation features:

-

The availability notice referenced above reports that new subscriptions and renewals have ended.


That makes it a temporary option only for existing subscribers with remaining access, not a choice for new iPhone users. Our[Dragon review and alternatives](https://willowvoice.com/blog/dragon-review-alternatives-comparison) guide can help you prepare a replacement before your subscription expires.

## FAQs


### How do you choose between Willow Voice, superwhisper, VoiceInk, and Monologue for your iPhone?


Start with where you need the finished text and what extra capability you want. Willow Voice and superwhisper work as iPhone keyboards, while VoiceInk and Monologue are standalone apps. VoiceInk adds an offline local-model option, and Monologue adds voice notes and bot-free meeting capture. Test your main task from recording through final sharing, including any copying and corrections.


### Should you start with Willow Voice or superwhisper if you are new to iPhone dictation?


Willow Voice may suit you if you prefer automatic vocabulary learning and unlimited free dictation without choosing models. superwhisper suits users who want configurable voice and AI model options, though it is worth checking its current plan terms to see which models and features are free. For your first session, use default settings and try a short message before changing anything.


### How can you compare writing quality in Willow Voice, superwhisper, and VoiceInk before paying?


Speak the same short passage into each app, including a name, a date, and a term you use often. Keep your microphone and surroundings consistent, then count errors and time the corrections needed to make the text ready to use. Judge the full task time, including moving the text into your preferred app.


### How should you move your writing workflow from Dragon Anywhere to Willow Voice, superwhisper, or Monologue?


While you still have Dragon Anywhere access, export important documents and save a list of recurring terms, client names, and formatting needs. Test Willow Voice for writing through an iPhone keyboard, since its vocabulary carries over across iOS, Windows, and Mac, or test superwhisper, whose iOS vocabulary is stored per device and must be recreated on the phone. Try Monologue if your work mainly involves spoken notes and meetings. Confirm that you can edit and share the resulting text before your existing subscription expires.

Check how the app handles names, corrections, and the vocabulary you use every day. Download Willow Voice for free, switch to its iOS keyboard, and dictate your next client reply. If it needs less editing than the app you use now, you have your answer.
